description: Filter or selection tag, with semantic tone and optional removal.

howToUse: Use it for filters people turn on and off above a list, and for choices shown inside a field.
Mark the active filter with `selected` and show how many items it has with `count`.
Use `removable` with `onRemove` for a choice that can be taken out, and update your list in it.
When only one chip of the row can be on, put the row in `ChipGroup` with `mode="single"` and a `label`: the group gives the arrow keys and one Tab stop.
For a row of independent filters with a name, use `ChipGroup` with `mode="multiple"`. Give each chip a `value`.
alternatives: A label people do not click: Badge.
The main action of the screen: Button.

keyboard.action: Moves from one chip to the next. In a single-choice ChipGroup, enters the selected chip and leaves the group.
Turns the chip on or off. On the ×, removes it.
In a single-choice ChipGroup, moves focus and selection to the next or previous chip, skipping disabled ones.
In a single-choice ChipGroup, selects the first or last chip.

props.name: variant
props.description: Compact selection embedded in fields; filter keeps the default.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected state (active filter).

props.name: count
props.description: Counter on the right (e.g. number of items in the filter).

props.name: tone
props.description: Optional semantic dot for severity/status filters.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description:
Toggle uses `aria-pressed`; radio uses `role=radio` + `aria-checked`.
Radio needs ChipGroup with `mode="single"` for arrow keys; inside a ChipGroup the group decides.

props.name: value
props.description: Value of the chip inside a ChipGroup. Defaults to the text of `children`.

props.name: showCheck
props.description: Shows the animated check when selected.

props.name: removable
props.description: Close icon: fires onRemove.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown by the component.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value in uncontrolled state.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS class.

props.name: style
props.description: The component's inline styles.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Activation callback.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label of the group, with the field label tokens.

props.name: mode
props.description: `single`: one chip at a time, arrow keys move focus and selection. `multiple`: each chip toggles.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected value (`single`) or values (`multiple`), controlled.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial selection in uncontrolled state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Receives the value (`single`) or the list of values (`multiple`).

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually; it keeps naming the group.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS class.

props.name: children
props.description: Chips with `value` (or plain text children).
